description: inventory-service core, built from scratch (HEAD only has a placeholder app: no StockService, controller or tests exist, contrary to the brief). Postgres + JPA + Flyway, atomic multi-instance-safe reservations with lifecycle HELD/CONFIRMED/SHIPPED, OAuth2 resource server on the Keycloak issuer requiring role inventory, ProblemDetail advice, correlation-id filter, tracing, virtual threads, Error Prone + NullAway. Kafka and expiry come in FEAT-004. Depends on FEAT-001 (compose, realm role); independent of FEAT-002.
steps: inventory-service/pom.xml: add the dependencies and the Error Prone/NullAway compiler block listed in plan.md Digest (copy from order-platform/pom.xml), testResources for the realm file (../order-platform/keycloak) and the WireMock stubs (../deploy/wiremock/inventory). Add package-info.java with @NullMarked in every package.

Replace application.properties with application.yaml (port 8081, virtual threads, jpa validate, resource-server block copied from order-platform, mvc.problemdetails, docker compose block with profiles.active inventory, management tracing defaults like order-platform, shopflow.inventory.hold-ttl 45m). Add application-dev.yaml (Flyway locations incl. db/dev) and db/dev/afterMigrate__dev_stock.sql seeding SKU-001..SKU-008 = 1000 idempotently.
Flyway: V1__create_stock.sql, V2__create_reservations.sql (reservation + reservation_line, status CHECK, index on status,created_at), V3__create_shedlock.sql.

domain/: entities, repositories (StockRepository conditional decrement and increment @Modifying queries), StockService with reserve (insert reservation on conflict do nothing; duplicate id -> return OK unchanged; merge duplicate SKUs; sorted SKU order; conditional decrement; any miss throws InsufficientStockException so the transaction rolls back), release (HELD/CONFIRMED -> return stock + delete; SHIPPED -> ReservationShippedException; absent -> ReservationNotFoundException), confirm/ship transitions that only move forward (used by FEAT-004), findStock. No synchronized, no in-process state.

api/: StockController with the exact contract (GET 200/404, POST 200 {reservationId} / 409 / 400, DELETE 204/404/409) and validation annotations; ApiExceptionHandler extends ResponseEntityExceptionHandler with ProblemDetail types for insufficient stock, reservation shipped, reservation not found (pattern of order-platform ApiExceptionHandler).

infra/: SecurityConfig (health open, /api/stock/** hasRole INVENTORY, anyRequest authenticated, stateless, csrf ignored for /api/**, public class), CorrelationId + CorrelationIdFilter, SchedulingConfig (Clock bean, ShedLock provider, @EnableScheduling, @EnableSchedulerLock) â€” the scheduling pieces are needed by FEAT-004 and by the shedlock table.

Tests: StockControllerTest (@WebMvcTest, jwt() with ROLE_INVENTORY, all status codes incl. 400/401/403, mocked StockService); StockRepositoryPostgresTest (@DataJpaTest + Testcontainers Postgres, concurrency test with N threads and crossing SKU orders, same reservationId from many threads, release/ship rules, no negative stock); TestcontainersConfiguration and KeycloakTestcontainersConfiguration copied from order-platform; abstract InventoryIntegrationTest base (one shared context, Postgres + Kafka + Keycloak, kafka listener auto-startup=false for now); SecurityIntegrationTest (401 no token, 403 alice token, 200 with service-account token; asserts the token has the inventory role). Convert InventoryServiceApplicationTests to use the base or remove it if the base covers context loading.
Run the app once by hand with the dev profile against the compose stack (docker compose up the inventory profile) to confirm Flyway, seeds and a curl round trip work; stop it.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/stock/reservations twice with the same reservationId returns 200 both times and takes stock once
A reservation with one uncovered or unknown SKU returns 409 ProblemDetail and no stock changes for any line
N concurrent reservations against stock S succeed exactly floor(S/q) times and available never goes below 0
DELETE of a SHIPPED reservation returns 409; of a HELD/CONFIRMED one returns 204 and restores stock; of an absent one returns 404
Calls without a token get 401, with a token lacking role inventory get 403, with the shopflow-service client-credentials token get 200
Responses carry X-Correlation-Id; invalid body returns 400 ProblemDetail
./mvnw -B -ntp -pl inventory-service verify passes with Error Prone/NullAway enabled
verification: ./mvnw -B -ntp -pl inventory-service verify  (script + log under inventory-service/target/; check surefire reports)
Manual: dev-profile run against docker compose --profile inventory stack, curl POST/GET/DELETE with and without a token
findings: Done. ./mvnw -B -ntp -pl inventory-service verify: 41 tests (StockControllerTest 12, SecurityIntegrationTest 9, StockRepositoryPostgresTest 20), 0 failures, 0 skips, BUILD SUCCESS in ~57 s (log inventory-service/target/feat003.log); Error Prone + NullAway ERROR on main and test code (NullAway also checks tests in the same package name as the @NullMarked main packages). Manual dev-profile run against the Boot-started compose stack (kafka, keycloak, postgres-inventory only; profile 'inventory' works as assumed): Flyway V1-V3 + dev seed OK, app on 8081; curl: no token 401, alice 403, service token GET SKU-001 1000, POST twice 200 (stock 995 once), uncovered 409, bad body 400, DELETE 204 (stock 1000), repeat DELETE 404; all stopped, compose down -v. Decisions/deviations: (1) application.yaml has NO kafka consumer block (value-deserializer, default.type com.shopflow.inventory.events.EventEnvelope, trusted packages): add it in FEAT-004 together with the events package; only bootstrap-servers, observation-enabled and auto-offset-reset are set. (2) No shopflow.inventory.expiry-cron / processed-events-retention properties yet; FEAT-004 adds them. hold-ttl 45m is in place. (3) Added server.port 8081 and jpa.open-in-view false. (4) Domain API: StockService.reserve(String, List<StockLine>) void, release(String), boolean confirm(String), boolean ship(String) (no-op false for unknown/already-forward), int available(String); exceptions InsufficientStockException(sku), ReservationNotFoundException, ReservationShippedException, UnknownSkuException (GET -> 404). Repositories: ReservationRepository.insertIfAbsent/markConfirmed/markShipped (native, now() timestamps), findForUpdate; ReservationLineRepository; StockRepository.decrementIfAvailable/increment. Reservation entity has reservationId/status/createdAt/updatedAt (Instant, timestamptz); reservation_line has surrogate identity id + unique (reservation_id, sku); reservation_id column is VARCHAR(100). Expiry job can select HELD ids with created_at < now - hold-ttl and call StockService.release per id (separate transaction each). SchedulingConfig (Clock bean, ShedLock, V3__create_shedlock.sql) is in place; FEAT-004 migrations are V4 processed_events, V5 dead_letters. (5) Test base: com.shopflow.inventory.InventoryIntegrationTest (RANDOM_PORT, RestTestClient, KeycloakContainer, JdbcClient, helpers serviceToken()/aliceToken(), property spring.kafka.listener.auto-startup=false: FEAT-004 changes only that); TestcontainersConfiguration (postgres 17 + kafka) and KeycloakTestcontainersConfiguration (issuer registrar only). InventoryServiceApplicationTests was removed (SecurityIntegrationTest loads the context). One Keycloak context ~33 s in test timings. (6) Response problem types: https://example.com/problems/{insufficient-stock,reservation-shipped,reservation-not-found,unknown-sku}; ApiExceptionHandler adds errors[] field list on 400 validation. Request limits: reservationId max 100, sku max 64, quantity 1..1_000_000. (7) Release of a SHIPPED reservation -> 409 as decided; the contract test in FEAT-004 can use it.
